fields.Name: IT124 - Job-title classifier consistency (live)
fields.Description: Live-model bundle 'fp-live-jobtitle': the installed job-title Feature Pipeline (bizapps-common), at temperature 0 with seed 42, classifies the 52 golden titles three times as a dry run with the Dedup Cache bypassed, so the model answers every time. Passes when seniority and the primary job function are identical across the three runs on 52/52 titles; it also reports how many full function lists (with confidences) were identical. Writes only AI Prompt Runs. Needs bizapps-common installed and a key for the pipeline's model vendor.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Seniority identical on 52/52 titles and primary job function identical on 52/52 titles across three runs.
